label: Slack: Get Thread
description: Reads a whole Slack thread, parent first then every reply, addressed by channel + the parent's ts. Over 10000 messages fails loudly.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: Needs channels:history (groups:history for private channels), and the app must be in the channel.

inputs.name: channel
inputs.label: Channel
inputs.placeholder: The channel id the thread lives in

outputs.name: messages
outputs.description: As Slack returns them: text, user, ts, reactions, ...

outputs.name: count
outputs.description: Messages in the thread, parent included.
